name: CMYK Halftone
desc: A drifting domain-warped source separated into cyan/magenta/yellow/black and screened through rotated dot grids at the classic 15/75/0/45 angles, beating into a full-color moire rosette print texture that boils and slowly turns like wet newsprint.
